_comment: Keep BIOME continentalness on Terra Continental's radial system even with Tectonic enabled. Tectonic's built-in pack also overrides minecraft:overworld/continents (-> its full_continents); this world datapack loads last and wins, so biome placement stays radial and the Python simulator remains a valid map oracle. Terrain height comes from the raw_continents seam; biome continentalness comes from here. They are allowed to be different functions.
